what: GPU clock behaviour and the boost pin, measured through libanubis_solver.so

machine.gpu: Intel Iris Xe Graphics (Alder Lake-P GT2)

api.anubis_gpu_boost: 1 pins gt_min_freq_mhz at the boost clock, 0 restores; -1 with EACCES when unprivileged
api.anubis_gpu_power_state: JSON: card, cur/act/min/max/boost/RP0/RPn MHz, writable, boost, profile
api.env: ANUBIS_GPU_BOOST=1 attempts the pin at library load

notes: the iGPU idles at 300 MHz and reaches 1400 MHz only in a short burst
sustained clock settles at 1100-1150 MHz under the performance profile (power/thermal)
discard the first solve when benchmarking a GPU: it measures the governor, not the kernel
